-- P1-E economy and first P1-F specimen collection in server memory. Runtime supplies trusted source IDs, rolls and
-- physical/context validation. Every accepted change commits with its receipt;
-- this module never yields, touches Instances or writes persistent account data.
local Rules = {}

Rules.Config = table.freeze({
	StarterCoins = 80,
	PurchaseCost = 10,
	MaxCarried = 3,
	OreCount = 6,
	CarveCount = 3,
	BonusCoins = 40,
	UpgradeBones = 2,
	UpgradeIron = 2,
	HammerMultiplier = 1.15,
	MaximumCount = 1000000000,
	MaximumSerial = 2147483647,
	RecentOperations = 64,
	RecentClosedRuns = 8,
	MaxOwnedSpecimens = 100,
	MaximumTimestamp = 253402300799,
})
local C = Rules.Config
local Materials = {"Skin", "Tooth", "Scale", "Bone", "Iron"}
local Items = {"RawTrap", "IronTrap", "SleepPotion"}
local RunStates = {Preparing = true, Hunting = true, Defeated = true, Captured = true, Failed = true}

local function clone(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local copy = {}
	for key, item in value do copy[key] = clone(item) end
	return copy
end

local function integer(value, maximum)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0
		and value <= (maximum or C.MaximumCount) and value % 1 == 0
end

local function id(value)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 128 and not value:find("%c")
end

local function serial(value)
	return integer(value, C.MaximumSerial) and value > 0
end

local function roll(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < 1
end

local function rejected(code)
	return {Ok = false, Code = code, Replay = false}
end

local function accepted(code, fields)
	local receipt = fields or {}
	receipt.Ok, receipt.Code, receipt.Replay = true, code, false
	return receipt
end

local function replay(receipt)
	local copy = clone(receipt)
	copy.Replay = true
	return copy
end

local function counts(container, keys)
	if type(container) ~= "table" then return false end
	for _, key in keys do if not integer(container[key]) then return false end end
	return true
end

local function guid(value)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value == 36
		and value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$") ~= nil
end

local SpecimenFields = {Id = true, SpeciesId = true, Name = true, Variant = true,
	Element = true, SizeScale = true, CapturedAt = true, SourceRunId = true, SourceMonsterId = true, Serial = true}

local function validSpecimen(record, owned)
	if type(record) ~= "table" or not guid(record.Id) or record.SpeciesId ~= "TRex"
		or record.Name ~= "T-Rex" or record.Variant ~= "Normal" or record.Element ~= "None"
		or record.SizeScale ~= 1 or not integer(record.CapturedAt, C.MaximumTimestamp)
		or not id(record.SourceRunId) or not id(record.SourceMonsterId) then return false end
	if owned then
		if not serial(record.Serial) then return false end
	elseif record.Serial ~= nil then return false end
	for key in record do if not SpecimenFields[key] then return false end end
	return true
end

-- Migration accepts validated, acyclic data, never an unreadable profile that
-- would otherwise fall back to fresh starter money. Receipts are kept intact.
local function plainTree(value, visiting, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then return value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
	if kind ~= "table" then return kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" end
	if depth > 12 or visiting[value] then return false end
	visiting[value] = true
	for key, child in value do
		if (type(key) ~= "string" and (type(key) ~= "number" or not integer(key, C.MaximumTimestamp)))
			or not plainTree(child, visiting, depth + 1) then visiting[value] = nil return false end
	end
	visiting[value] = nil
	return true
end

local function validReceipt(receipt)
	return type(receipt) == "table" and receipt.Ok == true and receipt.Replay == false
		and id(receipt.Code) and plainTree(receipt, {}, 0)
end

local function validClaims(claims)
	if type(claims) ~= "table" then return false end
	for key, receipt in claims do
		local known = key == "OpenRun" or key == "StartRun" or key == "Finish" or key == "CloseRun" or key == "Drop"
			or (type(key) == "string" and (key:match("^Ore:[1-6]$") or key:match("^Carve:[1-3]$")))
		if not known or not validReceipt(receipt) then return false end
	end
	return validReceipt(claims.OpenRun)
end

local function validRun(run)
	return type(run) == "table" and id(run.Id) and id(run.MonsterId) and serial(run.Serial)
		and RunStates[run.State] and integer(run.Traps, C.MaxCarried) and integer(run.Potions, C.MaxCarried)
		and integer(run.InitialTraps, C.MaxCarried) and integer(run.InitialPotions, C.MaxCarried)
		and run.Traps <= run.InitialTraps and run.Potions <= run.InitialPotions
		and integer(run.Carves, C.CarveCount) and validClaims(run.Claims)
end

local function validBaseProfile(profile, version)
	if type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.DataVersion ~= version or profile.StarterGranted ~= true
		or profile.StorageMode ~= "ServerMemory"
		or not integer(profile.Revision) or not integer(profile.Coins)
		or not counts(profile.Materials, Materials) or not counts(profile.StoredConsumables, Items)
		or (profile.HammerLevel ~= 1 and profile.HammerLevel ~= 2)
		or not integer(profile.RunSerial, C.MaximumSerial) or not integer(profile.OperationSerial, C.MaximumSerial)
		or type(profile.OperationReceipts) ~= "table" or type(profile.OperationOrder) ~= "table"
		or type(profile.ClosedRuns) ~= "table" or #profile.OperationOrder > C.RecentOperations
		or #profile.ClosedRuns > C.RecentClosedRuns then return false end
	if profile.ActiveRun ~= nil and (not validRun(profile.ActiveRun) or profile.ActiveRun.Serial ~= profile.RunSerial) then return false end
	local operations = {}
	for index, operationSerial in profile.OperationOrder do
		if not serial(index) or index > #profile.OperationOrder or not serial(operationSerial)
			or operationSerial > profile.OperationSerial or operations[operationSerial]
			or not validReceipt(profile.OperationReceipts[operationSerial]) then return false end
		operations[operationSerial] = true
	end
	for operationSerial, receipt in profile.OperationReceipts do
		if not operations[operationSerial] or receipt.OperationSerial ~= operationSerial then return false end
	end
	local closedIds, closedSerials = {}, {}
	for index, run in profile.ClosedRuns do
		if not serial(index) or index > #profile.ClosedRuns or type(run) ~= "table" or not id(run.Id)
			or not serial(run.Serial) or run.Serial > profile.RunSerial or not validClaims(run.Claims)
			or closedIds[run.Id] or closedSerials[run.Serial]
			or (profile.ActiveRun and (run.Id == profile.ActiveRun.Id or run.Serial == profile.ActiveRun.Serial)) then return false end
		closedIds[run.Id], closedSerials[run.Serial] = true, true
	end
	return true
end

local function specimenCount(profile)
	local count = 0
	for _ in profile.OwnedSpecimens do count += 1 end
	return count
end

local function validProfile(profile)
	if not validBaseProfile(profile, 2) or type(profile.OwnedSpecimens) ~= "table"
		or not integer(profile.SpecimenSerial, C.MaximumSerial) then return false end
	local count, serials, sourceRuns, sourceMonsters = 0, {}, {}, {}
	for key, record in profile.OwnedSpecimens do
		if not validSpecimen(record, true) or key ~= record.Id or record.Serial > profile.SpecimenSerial
			or serials[record.Serial] or sourceRuns[record.SourceRunId] or sourceMonsters[record.SourceMonsterId] then return false end
		count += 1
		if count > C.MaxOwnedSpecimens then return false end
		serials[record.Serial], sourceRuns[record.SourceRunId], sourceMonsters[record.SourceMonsterId] = true, true, true
	end
	return true
end

function Rules.new(existing)
	if existing ~= nil then
		if type(existing) == "table" and existing.DataVersion == 1 then
			if not validBaseProfile(existing, 1) or not plainTree(existing, {}, 0)
				or existing.OwnedSpecimens ~= nil or existing.SpecimenSerial ~= nil then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
			local migrated = clone(existing)
			migrated.DataVersion, migrated.OwnedSpecimens, migrated.SpecimenSerial = 2, {}, 0
			return migrated
		end
		if not validProfile(existing) or not plainTree(existing, {}, 0) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		return clone(existing)
	end
	return {
		DataVersion = 2, Revision = 0, StarterGranted = true, StorageMode = "ServerMemory",
		Coins = C.StarterCoins, HammerLevel = 1, RunSerial = 0, OperationSerial = 0,
		Materials = {Skin = 0, Tooth = 0, Scale = 0, Bone = 0, Iron = 0},
		StoredConsumables = {RawTrap = 0, IronTrap = 0, SleepPotion = 0},
		OperationReceipts = {}, OperationOrder = {}, ClosedRuns = {},
		OwnedSpecimens = {}, SpecimenSerial = 0,
	}
end

function Rules.canCapture(profile, runId, runSerial)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return false, "InvalidProfile" end
	if runId ~= nil or runSerial ~= nil then
		if not id(runId) or not serial(runSerial) then return false, "InvalidRun" end
		local run = profile.ActiveRun
		if not run or run.Id ~= runId or run.Serial ~= runSerial then return false, "StaleRun" end
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return false, "InvalidState" end
	end
	if specimenCount(profile) >= C.MaxOwnedSpecimens or profile.SpecimenSerial >= C.MaximumSerial then return false, "SpecimenCapacity" end
	return true, "Ready"
end

local function commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	if not validProfile(nextProfile) then return rejected("InvalidResult") end
	if profile.Revision >= C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
	nextProfile.Revision = profile.Revision + 1
	for key in profile do profile[key] = nil end
	for key, value in nextProfile do profile[key] = value end
	return clone(receipt)
end

local function add(container, key, quantity)
	if not integer(quantity) or not integer(container[key]) or container[key] + quantity > C.MaximumCount then return false end
	container[key] += quantity
	return true
end

local function typeFor(sample)
	if not roll(sample) then return nil end
	if sample < 0.5 then return "Skin" end
	if sample < 0.75 then return "Tooth" end
	return "Scale"
end

local function sync(run, request)
	if request.Traps == nil and request.Potions == nil then return true end
	if not integer(request.Traps, C.MaxCarried) or not integer(request.Potions, C.MaxCarried)
		or request.Traps > run.Traps or request.Potions > run.Potions then return false end
	run.Traps, run.Potions = request.Traps, request.Potions
	return true
end

local function currentRun(profile, request)
	if not id(request.RunId) or not serial(request.RunSerial) then return nil, "InvalidRun" end
	local run = profile.ActiveRun
	if run and run.Id == request.RunId and run.Serial == request.RunSerial then return run end
	return nil, "StaleRun"
end

local function closedRun(profile, request)
	for _, record in profile.ClosedRuns do
		if record.Id == request.RunId and record.Serial == request.RunSerial then return record end
	end
	return nil
end

local function requestKey(request)
	if request.Op == "Ore" and integer(request.Index, C.OreCount) and request.Index > 0 then return "Ore:" .. request.Index end
	if request.Op == "Carve" and integer(request.Index, C.CarveCount) and request.Index > 0 then return "Carve:" .. request.Index end
	if request.Op == "Drop" or request.Op == "StartRun" or request.Op == "Finish" or request.Op == "CloseRun" then return request.Op end
	return nil
end

local function runTransaction(profile, request)
	local run, failure = currentRun(profile, request)
	local key = requestKey(request)
	if not run then
		local closed = closedRun(profile, request)
		if closed and key and closed.Claims[key] then return replay(closed.Claims[key]) end
		return rejected(failure)
	end
	if key and run.Claims[key] then return replay(run.Claims[key]) end
	local nextProfile = clone(profile)
	local nextRun = nextProfile.ActiveRun
	local receipt
	if request.Op == "StartRun" then
		if run.State ~= "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		nextRun.State = "Hunting"
		receipt = accepted("Started", {RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "SyncItems" then
		if run.State == "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not sync(nextRun, request) or request.Traps == nil then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
		if nextRun.Traps == run.Traps and nextRun.Potions == run.Potions then
			return accepted("Synced", {Traps = run.Traps, Potions = run.Potions, Unchanged = true})
		end
		receipt = accepted("Synced", {Traps = nextRun.Traps, Potions = nextRun.Potions})
	elseif request.Op == "Finish" then
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if request.Result ~= "Defeated" and request.Result ~= "Captured" and request.Result ~= "Failed" then return rejected("InvalidOutcome") end
		if not sync(nextRun, request) then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
		local rewards, capturedSpecimen = {}, nil
		if request.Result == "Captured" then
			if nextRun.InitialTraps - nextRun.Traps < 1 or nextRun.InitialPotions - nextRun.Potions < 1 then return rejected("CaptureItemsMissing") end
			if type(request.Rolls) ~= "table" or #request.Rolls ~= 3 then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
			if not validSpecimen(request.Specimen, false) or request.Specimen.SourceRunId ~= run.Id
				or request.Specimen.SourceMonsterId ~= run.MonsterId then return rejected("InvalidSpecimen") end
			for specimenId, specimen in profile.OwnedSpecimens do
				if specimenId == request.Specimen.Id or specimen.SourceRunId == run.Id
					or specimen.SourceMonsterId == run.MonsterId then return rejected("DuplicateSpecimen") end
			end
			local available, capacityCode = Rules.canCapture(profile, run.Id, run.Serial)
			if not available then return rejected(capacityCode) end
			for index = 1, 3 do
				local sample = request.Rolls[index]
				if type(sample) ~= "table" or not roll(sample.QuantityRoll) then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
				local material = typeFor(sample.TypeRoll)
				if not material then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
				local quantity = if sample.QuantityRoll < 0.5 then 1 else 2
				if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, quantity) then return rejected("Capacity") end
				table.insert(rewards, {Material = material, Quantity = quantity})
			end
			nextProfile.SpecimenSerial += 1
			capturedSpecimen = clone(request.Specimen)
			capturedSpecimen.Serial = nextProfile.SpecimenSerial
			nextProfile.OwnedSpecimens[capturedSpecimen.Id] = capturedSpecimen
		end
		if request.Result ~= "Failed" then
			if not add(nextProfile.Materials, "Bone", 1) or nextProfile.Coins + C.BonusCoins > C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
			nextProfile.Coins += C.BonusCoins
		end
		nextRun.State = request.Result
		nextRun.Result = request.Result
		receipt = accepted("Finished", {Result = request.Result, Rewards = rewards,
			BonusBone = if request.Result == "Failed" then 0 else 1,
			BonusCoins = if request.Result == "Failed" then 0 else C.BonusCoins,
			SpecimenId = if capturedSpecimen then capturedSpecimen.Id else nil,
			Specimen = if capturedSpecimen then clone(capturedSpecimen) else nil,
			Traps = nextRun.Traps, Potions = nextRun.Potions, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "Ore" or request.Op == "Drop" then
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" and run.State ~= "Defeated" and run.State ~= "Captured" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not key then return rejected("InvalidIndex") end
		local material = if request.Op == "Ore" then "Iron" else "Scale"
		if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		receipt = accepted("PickupGranted", {Material = material, Quantity = 1, Source = key, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "Carve" then
		if run.State ~= "Defeated" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not key or request.Index ~= run.Carves + 1 then return rejected("InvalidIndex") end
		local material = typeFor(request.TypeRoll)
		if not material then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
		if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextRun.Carves += 1
		receipt = accepted("CarveGranted", {Material = material, Quantity = 1, Index = request.Index, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "CloseRun" then
		if request.EntryFailed ~= nil and type(request.EntryFailed) ~= "boolean" then return rejected("InvalidEntryFailure") end
		if request.EntryFailed == true then
			if run.State ~= "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
			nextRun.Traps, nextRun.Potions = run.InitialTraps, run.InitialPotions
			nextRun.Result = "EntryFailed"
		else
			if run.State == "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
			if not sync(nextRun, request) then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
			if run.State == "Hunting" then nextRun.State, nextRun.Result = "Failed", "Failed" end
		end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "IronTrap", nextRun.Traps)
			or not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "SleepPotion", nextRun.Potions) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		receipt = accepted("Closed", {Result = nextRun.Result, ReturnedTraps = nextRun.Traps,
			ReturnedPotions = nextRun.Potions, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
		nextRun.Claims[key] = clone(receipt)
		table.insert(nextProfile.ClosedRuns, {Id = nextRun.Id, Serial = nextRun.Serial, Claims = nextRun.Claims})
		while #nextProfile.ClosedRuns > C.RecentClosedRuns do table.remove(nextProfile.ClosedRuns, 1) end
		nextProfile.ActiveRun = nil
		return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	else
		return rejected("InvalidOperation")
	end
	if key then nextRun.Claims[key] = clone(receipt) end
	return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
end

local function baseTransaction(profile, request)
	if not serial(request.OperationSerial) then return rejected("InvalidSerial") end
	local cached = profile.OperationReceipts[request.OperationSerial]
	if cached then return replay(cached) end
	if request.OperationSerial ~= profile.OperationSerial + 1 then return rejected("StaleOperation") end
	if profile.ActiveRun then return rejected("ActiveRun") end
	if request.Quantity ~= nil and request.Quantity ~= 1 then return rejected("InvalidQuantity") end
	local nextProfile, receipt = clone(profile)
	if request.Op == "Buy" then
		if request.Item ~= "RawTrap" and request.Item ~= "SleepPotion" then return rejected("InvalidItem") end
		if profile.Coins < C.PurchaseCost then return rejected("InsufficientCoins") end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, request.Item, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.Coins -= C.PurchaseCost
		receipt = accepted("Purchased", {Item = request.Item, Quantity = 1, Cost = C.PurchaseCost})
	elseif request.Op == "CraftTrap" then
		if profile.StoredConsumables.RawTrap < 1 or profile.Materials.Iron < 1 then return rejected("InsufficientMaterials") end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "IronTrap", 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.RawTrap -= 1
		nextProfile.Materials.Iron -= 1
		receipt = accepted("Crafted", {Item = "IronTrap", Quantity = 1})
	elseif request.Op == "UpgradeHammer" then
		if profile.HammerLevel ~= 1 then return rejected("MaximumLevel") end
		if profile.Materials.Bone < C.UpgradeBones or profile.Materials.Iron < C.UpgradeIron then return rejected("InsufficientMaterials") end
		nextProfile.Materials.Bone -= C.UpgradeBones
		nextProfile.Materials.Iron -= C.UpgradeIron
		nextProfile.HammerLevel = 2
		receipt = accepted("Upgraded", {HammerLevel = 2, DamageMultiplier = C.HammerMultiplier})
	else
		return rejected("InvalidOperation")
	end
	nextProfile.OperationSerial = request.OperationSerial
	receipt.OperationSerial = request.OperationSerial
	nextProfile.OperationReceipts[request.OperationSerial] = clone(receipt)
	table.insert(nextProfile.OperationOrder, request.OperationSerial)
	while #nextProfile.OperationOrder > C.RecentOperations do
		local oldest = table.remove(nextProfile.OperationOrder, 1)
		nextProfile.OperationReceipts[oldest] = nil
	end
	return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
end

function Rules.apply(profile, request)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return rejected("InvalidProfile") end
	if type(request) ~= "table" or type(request.Op) ~= "string" then return rejected("InvalidRequest") end
	if request.Op == "OpenRun" then
		if not id(request.RunId) or not id(request.MonsterId) or not serial(request.RunSerial) then return rejected("InvalidRun") end
		if profile.ActiveRun and profile.ActiveRun.Id == request.RunId and profile.ActiveRun.Serial == request.RunSerial then
			return replay(profile.ActiveRun.Claims.OpenRun)
		end
		local old = closedRun(profile, request)
		if old and old.Claims.OpenRun then return replay(old.Claims.OpenRun) end
		if profile.ActiveRun then return rejected("ActiveRun") end
		if request.RunSerial ~= profile.RunSerial + 1 then return rejected("StaleRun") end
		local nextProfile = clone(profile)
		local traps = math.min(C.MaxCarried, profile.StoredConsumables.IronTrap)
		local potions = math.min(C.MaxCarried, profile.StoredConsumables.SleepPotion)
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.IronTrap -= traps
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.SleepPotion -= potions
		nextProfile.RunSerial = request.RunSerial
		local receipt = accepted("Opened", {RunId = request.RunId, MonsterId = request.MonsterId,
			RunSerial = request.RunSerial, Traps = traps, Potions = potions})
		nextProfile.ActiveRun = {Id = request.RunId, MonsterId = request.MonsterId, Serial = request.RunSerial,
			State = "Preparing", Traps = traps, Potions = potions, InitialTraps = traps, InitialPotions = potions,
			Carves = 0, Claims = {OpenRun = clone(receipt)}}
		return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	end
	if request.Op == "Buy" or request.Op == "CraftTrap" or request.Op == "UpgradeHammer" then
		return baseTransaction(profile, request)
	end
	return runTransaction(profile, request)
end

function Rules.snapshot(profile)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return nil end
	local active = profile.ActiveRun
	return {DataVersion = profile.DataVersion, Revision = profile.Revision, StarterGranted = profile.StarterGranted,
		StorageMode = "ServerMemory", Coins = profile.Coins, Materials = clone(profile.Materials),
		StoredConsumables = clone(profile.StoredConsumables), HammerLevel = profile.HammerLevel,
		RunSerial = profile.RunSerial, OperationSerial = profile.OperationSerial,
		OwnedSpecimens = clone(profile.OwnedSpecimens), SpecimenSerial = profile.SpecimenSerial,
		SpecimenCount = specimenCount(profile), SpecimenLimit = C.MaxOwnedSpecimens,
		ActiveRun = if active then {Id = active.Id, MonsterId = active.MonsterId, Serial = active.Serial,
			State = active.State, Result = active.Result, Traps = active.Traps, Potions = active.Potions,
			InitialTraps = active.InitialTraps, InitialPotions = active.InitialPotions, Carves = active.Carves} else nil}
end

function Rules.damageMultiplier(profile)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return nil end
	return if profile.HammerLevel == 2 then C.HammerMultiplier else 1
end

return Rules

-- P1-E economy and first P1-F specimen collection in server memory. Runtime supplies trusted source IDs, rolls and
-- physical/context validation. Every accepted change commits with its receipt;
-- this module never yields, touches Instances or writes persistent account data.
local Rules = {}

Rules.Config = table.freeze({
	StarterCoins = 80,
	PurchaseCost = 10,
	MaxCarried = 3,
	OreCount = 6,
	CarveCount = 3,
	BonusCoins = 40,
	UpgradeBones = 2,
	UpgradeIron = 2,
	HammerMultiplier = 1.15,
	MaximumCount = 1000000000,
	MaximumSerial = 2147483647,
	RecentOperations = 64,
	RecentClosedRuns = 8,
	MaxOwnedSpecimens = 100,
	DisplaySlotCount = 5,
	MaximumTimestamp = 253402300799,
})
local C = Rules.Config
local Materials = {"Skin", "Tooth", "Scale", "Bone", "Iron"}
local Items = {"RawTrap", "IronTrap", "SleepPotion"}
local RunStates = {Preparing = true, Hunting = true, Defeated = true, Captured = true, Failed = true}

local function clone(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local copy = {}
	for key, item in value do copy[key] = clone(item) end
	return copy
end

local function integer(value, maximum)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0
		and value <= (maximum or C.MaximumCount) and value % 1 == 0
end

local function id(value)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 128 and not value:find("%c")
end

local function serial(value)
	return integer(value, C.MaximumSerial) and value > 0
end

local function roll(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < 1
end

local function rejected(code)
	return {Ok = false, Code = code, Replay = false}
end

local function accepted(code, fields)
	local receipt = fields or {}
	receipt.Ok, receipt.Code, receipt.Replay = true, code, false
	return receipt
end

local function replay(receipt)
	local copy = clone(receipt)
	copy.Replay = true
	return copy
end

local function counts(container, keys)
	if type(container) ~= "table" then return false end
	for _, key in keys do if not integer(container[key]) then return false end end
	return true
end

local function guid(value)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value == 36
		and value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$") ~= nil
end

local SpecimenFields = {Id = true, SpeciesId = true, Name = true, Variant = true,
	Element = true, SizeScale = true, CapturedAt = true, SourceRunId = true, SourceMonsterId = true, Serial = true}

local function validSpecimen(record, owned)
	if type(record) ~= "table" or not guid(record.Id) or record.SpeciesId ~= "TRex"
		or record.Name ~= "T-Rex" or record.Variant ~= "Normal" or record.Element ~= "None"
		or record.SizeScale ~= 1 or not integer(record.CapturedAt, C.MaximumTimestamp)
		or not id(record.SourceRunId) or not id(record.SourceMonsterId) then return false end
	if owned then
		if not serial(record.Serial) then return false end
	elseif record.Serial ~= nil then return false end
	for key in record do if not SpecimenFields[key] then return false end end
	return true
end

-- Migration accepts validated, acyclic data, never an unreadable profile that
-- would otherwise fall back to fresh starter money. Receipts are kept intact.
local function plainTree(value, visiting, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then return value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
	if kind ~= "table" then return kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" end
	if depth > 12 or visiting[value] then return false end
	visiting[value] = true
	for key, child in value do
		if (type(key) ~= "string" and (type(key) ~= "number" or not integer(key, C.MaximumTimestamp)))
			or not plainTree(child, visiting, depth + 1) then visiting[value] = nil return false end
	end
	visiting[value] = nil
	return true
end

local function validReceipt(receipt)
	return type(receipt) == "table" and receipt.Ok == true and receipt.Replay == false
		and id(receipt.Code) and plainTree(receipt, {}, 0)
end

local function validClaims(claims)
	if type(claims) ~= "table" then return false end
	for key, receipt in claims do
		local known = key == "OpenRun" or key == "StartRun" or key == "Finish" or key == "CloseRun" or key == "Drop"
			or (type(key) == "string" and (key:match("^Ore:[1-6]$") or key:match("^Carve:[1-3]$")))
		if not known or not validReceipt(receipt) then return false end
	end
	return validReceipt(claims.OpenRun)
end

local function validRun(run)
	return type(run) == "table" and id(run.Id) and id(run.MonsterId) and serial(run.Serial)
		and RunStates[run.State] and integer(run.Traps, C.MaxCarried) and integer(run.Potions, C.MaxCarried)
		and integer(run.InitialTraps, C.MaxCarried) and integer(run.InitialPotions, C.MaxCarried)
		and run.Traps <= run.InitialTraps and run.Potions <= run.InitialPotions
		and integer(run.Carves, C.CarveCount) and validClaims(run.Claims)
end

local function validBaseProfile(profile, version)
	if type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.DataVersion ~= version or profile.StarterGranted ~= true
		or profile.StorageMode ~= "ServerMemory"
		or not integer(profile.Revision) or not integer(profile.Coins)
		or not counts(profile.Materials, Materials) or not counts(profile.StoredConsumables, Items)
		or (profile.HammerLevel ~= 1 and profile.HammerLevel ~= 2)
		or not integer(profile.RunSerial, C.MaximumSerial) or not integer(profile.OperationSerial, C.MaximumSerial)
		or type(profile.OperationReceipts) ~= "table" or type(profile.OperationOrder) ~= "table"
		or type(profile.ClosedRuns) ~= "table" or #profile.OperationOrder > C.RecentOperations
		or #profile.ClosedRuns > C.RecentClosedRuns then return false end
	if profile.ActiveRun ~= nil and (not validRun(profile.ActiveRun) or profile.ActiveRun.Serial ~= profile.RunSerial) then return false end
	local operations = {}
	for index, operationSerial in profile.OperationOrder do
		if not serial(index) or index > #profile.OperationOrder or not serial(operationSerial)
			or operationSerial > profile.OperationSerial or operations[operationSerial]
			or not validReceipt(profile.OperationReceipts[operationSerial]) then return false end
		operations[operationSerial] = true
	end
	for operationSerial, receipt in profile.OperationReceipts do
		if not operations[operationSerial] or receipt.OperationSerial ~= operationSerial then return false end
	end
	local closedIds, closedSerials = {}, {}
	for index, run in profile.ClosedRuns do
		if not serial(index) or index > #profile.ClosedRuns or type(run) ~= "table" or not id(run.Id)
			or not serial(run.Serial) or run.Serial > profile.RunSerial or not validClaims(run.Claims)
			or closedIds[run.Id] or closedSerials[run.Serial]
			or (profile.ActiveRun and (run.Id == profile.ActiveRun.Id or run.Serial == profile.ActiveRun.Serial)) then return false end
		closedIds[run.Id], closedSerials[run.Serial] = true, true
	end
	return true
end

local function specimenCount(profile)
	local count = 0
	for _ in profile.OwnedSpecimens do count += 1 end
	return count
end

local function validDisplaySlots(profile)
	if type(profile.DisplaySlots) ~= "table" then return false end
	local displayed = {}
	for slot, specimenId in profile.DisplaySlots do
		if not integer(slot, C.DisplaySlotCount) or slot == 0 or not guid(specimenId)
			or not profile.OwnedSpecimens[specimenId] or displayed[specimenId] then return false end
		displayed[specimenId] = true
	end
	return true
end

local function validProfile(profile)
	if not validBaseProfile(profile, 2) or type(profile.OwnedSpecimens) ~= "table"
		or not integer(profile.SpecimenSerial, C.MaximumSerial)
		or type(profile.RedeemedCodes) ~= "table" then return false end
	-- Permanent code receipts are independent of the bounded purchase ledger.
	for codeId, receipt in profile.RedeemedCodes do
		if not id(codeId) or not validReceipt(receipt) or receipt.Code ~= "CodeRedeemed"
			or receipt.CodeId ~= codeId or not integer(receipt.RedeemedAt, C.MaximumTimestamp)
			or not integer(receipt.Coins) or receipt.Coins == 0
			or not counts(receipt.Materials, Materials) then return false end
		for material, quantity in receipt.Materials do
			if not table.find(Materials, material) or quantity == 0 then return false end
		end
		local allowed = {Ok=true,Code=true,Replay=true,CodeId=true,Coins=true,Materials=true,RedeemedAt=true}
		for field in receipt do if not allowed[field] then return false end end
	end
	local count, serials, sourceRuns, sourceMonsters = 0, {}, {}, {}
	for key, record in profile.OwnedSpecimens do
		if not validSpecimen(record, true) or key ~= record.Id or record.Serial > profile.SpecimenSerial
			or serials[record.Serial] or sourceRuns[record.SourceRunId] or sourceMonsters[record.SourceMonsterId] then return false end
		count += 1
		if count > C.MaxOwnedSpecimens then return false end
		serials[record.Serial], sourceRuns[record.SourceRunId], sourceMonsters[record.SourceMonsterId] = true, true, true
	end
	return validDisplaySlots(profile)
end

function Rules.new(existing)
	if existing ~= nil then
		if type(existing) == "table" and existing.DataVersion == 1 then
			if not validBaseProfile(existing, 1) or not plainTree(existing, {}, 0)
				or existing.OwnedSpecimens ~= nil or existing.SpecimenSerial ~= nil
				or (existing.DisplaySlots ~= nil and (type(existing.DisplaySlots) ~= "table" or next(existing.DisplaySlots) ~= nil)) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
			local migrated = clone(existing)
			migrated.DataVersion, migrated.OwnedSpecimens, migrated.SpecimenSerial = 2, {}, 0
			migrated.DisplaySlots = {}
			if migrated.RedeemedCodes == nil then migrated.RedeemedCodes = {} end
			if not validProfile(migrated) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
			return migrated
		end
		if not plainTree(existing, {}, 0) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		local normalized = clone(existing)
		if type(normalized) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		-- Existing v2 collections predate tube assignments. Add only the new field.
		if normalized.DisplaySlots == nil then normalized.DisplaySlots = {} end
		if normalized.RedeemedCodes == nil then normalized.RedeemedCodes = {} end
		if not validProfile(normalized) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		return normalized
	end
	return {
		DataVersion = 2, Revision = 0, StarterGranted = true, StorageMode = "ServerMemory",
		Coins = C.StarterCoins, HammerLevel = 1, RunSerial = 0, OperationSerial = 0,
		Materials = {Skin = 0, Tooth = 0, Scale = 0, Bone = 0, Iron = 0},
		StoredConsumables = {RawTrap = 0, IronTrap = 0, SleepPotion = 0},
		OperationReceipts = {}, OperationOrder = {}, ClosedRuns = {},
		OwnedSpecimens = {}, SpecimenSerial = 0, DisplaySlots = {}, RedeemedCodes = {},
	}
end

function Rules.canCapture(profile, runId, runSerial)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return false, "InvalidProfile" end
	if runId ~= nil or runSerial ~= nil then
		if not id(runId) or not serial(runSerial) then return false, "InvalidRun" end
		local run = profile.ActiveRun
		if not run or run.Id ~= runId or run.Serial ~= runSerial then return false, "StaleRun" end
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return false, "InvalidState" end
	end
	if specimenCount(profile) >= C.MaxOwnedSpecimens or profile.SpecimenSerial >= C.MaximumSerial then return false, "SpecimenCapacity" end
	return true, "Ready"
end

local function commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	if not validProfile(nextProfile) then return rejected("InvalidResult") end
	if profile.Revision >= C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
	nextProfile.Revision = profile.Revision + 1
	for key in profile do profile[key] = nil end
	for key, value in nextProfile do profile[key] = value end
	return clone(receipt)
end

local function add(container, key, quantity)
	if not integer(quantity) or not integer(container[key]) or container[key] + quantity > C.MaximumCount then return false end
	container[key] += quantity
	return true
end

local function typeFor(sample)
	if not roll(sample) then return nil end
	if sample < 0.5 then return "Skin" end
	if sample < 0.75 then return "Tooth" end
	return "Scale"
end

local function sync(run, request)
	if request.Traps == nil and request.Potions == nil then return true end
	if not integer(request.Traps, C.MaxCarried) or not integer(request.Potions, C.MaxCarried)
		or request.Traps > run.Traps or request.Potions > run.Potions then return false end
	run.Traps, run.Potions = request.Traps, request.Potions
	return true
end

local function currentRun(profile, request)
	if not id(request.RunId) or not serial(request.RunSerial) then return nil, "InvalidRun" end
	local run = profile.ActiveRun
	if run and run.Id == request.RunId and run.Serial == request.RunSerial then return run end
	return nil, "StaleRun"
end

local function closedRun(profile, request)
	for _, record in profile.ClosedRuns do
		if record.Id == request.RunId and record.Serial == request.RunSerial then return record end
	end
	return nil
end

local function requestKey(request)
	if request.Op == "Ore" and integer(request.Index, C.OreCount) and request.Index > 0 then return "Ore:" .. request.Index end
	if request.Op == "Carve" and integer(request.Index, C.CarveCount) and request.Index > 0 then return "Carve:" .. request.Index end
	if request.Op == "Drop" or request.Op == "StartRun" or request.Op == "Finish" or request.Op == "CloseRun" then return request.Op end
	return nil
end

local function runTransaction(profile, request)
	local run, failure = currentRun(profile, request)
	local key = requestKey(request)
	if not run then
		local closed = closedRun(profile, request)
		if closed and key and closed.Claims[key] then return replay(closed.Claims[key]) end
		return rejected(failure)
	end
	if key and run.Claims[key] then return replay(run.Claims[key]) end
	local nextProfile = clone(profile)
	local nextRun = nextProfile.ActiveRun
	local receipt
	if request.Op == "StartRun" then
		if run.State ~= "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		nextRun.State = "Hunting"
		receipt = accepted("Started", {RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "SyncItems" then
		if run.State == "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not sync(nextRun, request) or request.Traps == nil then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
		if nextRun.Traps == run.Traps and nextRun.Potions == run.Potions then
			return accepted("Synced", {Traps = run.Traps, Potions = run.Potions, Unchanged = true})
		end
		receipt = accepted("Synced", {Traps = nextRun.Traps, Potions = nextRun.Potions})
	elseif request.Op == "Finish" then
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if request.Result ~= "Defeated" and request.Result ~= "Captured" and request.Result ~= "Failed" then return rejected("InvalidOutcome") end
		if not sync(nextRun, request) then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
		local rewards, capturedSpecimen = {}, nil
		if request.Result == "Captured" then
			if nextRun.InitialTraps - nextRun.Traps < 1 or nextRun.InitialPotions - nextRun.Potions < 1 then return rejected("CaptureItemsMissing") end
			if type(request.Rolls) ~= "table" or #request.Rolls ~= 3 then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
			if not validSpecimen(request.Specimen, false) or request.Specimen.SourceRunId ~= run.Id
				or request.Specimen.SourceMonsterId ~= run.MonsterId then return rejected("InvalidSpecimen") end
			for specimenId, specimen in profile.OwnedSpecimens do
				if specimenId == request.Specimen.Id or specimen.SourceRunId == run.Id
					or specimen.SourceMonsterId == run.MonsterId then return rejected("DuplicateSpecimen") end
			end
			local available, capacityCode = Rules.canCapture(profile, run.Id, run.Serial)
			if not available then return rejected(capacityCode) end
			for index = 1, 3 do
				local sample = request.Rolls[index]
				if type(sample) ~= "table" or not roll(sample.QuantityRoll) then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
				local material = typeFor(sample.TypeRoll)
				if not material then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
				local quantity = if sample.QuantityRoll < 0.5 then 1 else 2
				if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, quantity) then return rejected("Capacity") end
				table.insert(rewards, {Material = material, Quantity = quantity})
			end
			nextProfile.SpecimenSerial += 1
			capturedSpecimen = clone(request.Specimen)
			capturedSpecimen.Serial = nextProfile.SpecimenSerial
			nextProfile.OwnedSpecimens[capturedSpecimen.Id] = capturedSpecimen
		end
		if request.Result ~= "Failed" then
			if not add(nextProfile.Materials, "Bone", 1) or nextProfile.Coins + C.BonusCoins > C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
			nextProfile.Coins += C.BonusCoins
		end
		nextRun.State = request.Result
		nextRun.Result = request.Result
		receipt = accepted("Finished", {Result = request.Result, Rewards = rewards,
			BonusBone = if request.Result == "Failed" then 0 else 1,
			BonusCoins = if request.Result == "Failed" then 0 else C.BonusCoins,
			SpecimenId = if capturedSpecimen then capturedSpecimen.Id else nil,
			Specimen = if capturedSpecimen then clone(capturedSpecimen) else nil,
			Traps = nextRun.Traps, Potions = nextRun.Potions, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "Ore" or request.Op == "Drop" then
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" and run.State ~= "Defeated" and run.State ~= "Captured" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not key then return rejected("InvalidIndex") end
		local material = if request.Op == "Ore" then "Iron" else "Scale"
		if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		receipt = accepted("PickupGranted", {Material = material, Quantity = 1, Source = key, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "Carve" then
		if run.State ~= "Defeated" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not key or request.Index ~= run.Carves + 1 then return rejected("InvalidIndex") end
		local material = typeFor(request.TypeRoll)
		if not material then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
		if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextRun.Carves += 1
		receipt = accepted("CarveGranted", {Material = material, Quantity = 1, Index = request.Index, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "CloseRun" then
		if request.EntryFailed ~= nil and type(request.EntryFailed) ~= "boolean" then return rejected("InvalidEntryFailure") end
		if request.EntryFailed == true then
			if run.State ~= "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
			nextRun.Traps, nextRun.Potions = run.InitialTraps, run.InitialPotions
			nextRun.Result = "EntryFailed"
		else
			if run.State == "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
			if not sync(nextRun, request) then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
			if run.State == "Hunting" then nextRun.State, nextRun.Result = "Failed", "Failed" end
		end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "IronTrap", nextRun.Traps)
			or not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "SleepPotion", nextRun.Potions) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		receipt = accepted("Closed", {Result = nextRun.Result, ReturnedTraps = nextRun.Traps,
			ReturnedPotions = nextRun.Potions, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
		nextRun.Claims[key] = clone(receipt)
		table.insert(nextProfile.ClosedRuns, {Id = nextRun.Id, Serial = nextRun.Serial, Claims = nextRun.Claims})
		while #nextProfile.ClosedRuns > C.RecentClosedRuns do table.remove(nextProfile.ClosedRuns, 1) end
		nextProfile.ActiveRun = nil
		return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	else
		return rejected("InvalidOperation")
	end
	if key then nextRun.Claims[key] = clone(receipt) end
	return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
end

local function baseTransaction(profile, request)
	if not serial(request.OperationSerial) then return rejected("InvalidSerial") end
	local cached = profile.OperationReceipts[request.OperationSerial]
	if cached then return replay(cached) end
	if request.OperationSerial ~= profile.OperationSerial + 1 then return rejected("StaleOperation") end
	if profile.ActiveRun then return rejected("ActiveRun") end
	if request.Quantity ~= nil and request.Quantity ~= 1 then return rejected("InvalidQuantity") end
	local nextProfile, receipt = clone(profile)
	if request.Op == "Buy" then
		if request.Item ~= "RawTrap" and request.Item ~= "SleepPotion" then return rejected("InvalidItem") end
		if profile.Coins < C.PurchaseCost then return rejected("InsufficientCoins") end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, request.Item, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.Coins -= C.PurchaseCost
		receipt = accepted("Purchased", {Item = request.Item, Quantity = 1, Cost = C.PurchaseCost})
	elseif request.Op == "CraftTrap" then
		if profile.StoredConsumables.RawTrap < 1 or profile.Materials.Iron < 1 then return rejected("InsufficientMaterials") end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "IronTrap", 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.RawTrap -= 1
		nextProfile.Materials.Iron -= 1
		receipt = accepted("Crafted", {Item = "IronTrap", Quantity = 1})
	elseif request.Op == "UpgradeHammer" then
		if profile.HammerLevel ~= 1 then return rejected("MaximumLevel") end
		if profile.Materials.Bone < C.UpgradeBones or profile.Materials.Iron < C.UpgradeIron then return rejected("InsufficientMaterials") end
		nextProfile.Materials.Bone -= C.UpgradeBones
		nextProfile.Materials.Iron -= C.UpgradeIron
		nextProfile.HammerLevel = 2
		receipt = accepted("Upgraded", {HammerLevel = 2, DamageMultiplier = C.HammerMultiplier})
	elseif request.Op == "SetDisplaySlot" then
		if not integer(request.Slot, C.DisplaySlotCount) or request.Slot == 0 then return rejected("InvalidDisplaySlot") end
		local specimenId = request.SpecimenId
		if specimenId ~= false and specimenId ~= nil then

		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.IronTrap -= traps

			RunSerial = request.RunSerial, Traps = traps, Potions = potions})

			State = "Preparing", Traps = traps, Potions = potions, InitialTraps = traps, InitialPotions = potions,

		return baseTransaction(profile, request)

-- Shared native/offline placement contract. Local -Z faces back toward spawn;
-- offsets within the five-tube V are applied after this collision-aware frame.
function Geometry.clusterFrame(spawnPosition: Vector3, shelterPosition: Vector3, baseId: number): CFrame
	assert(typeof(spawnPosition) == "Vector3" and typeof(shelterPosition) == "Vector3", "Base positions must be Vector3")
	local layout = assert(Geometry.ClusterLayout[baseId], "Unknown bio-tube base")
	local difference = shelterPosition - spawnPosition
	local back = V(difference.X, 0, difference.Z)
	assert(back.Magnitude > .001, "Base has no valid shelter-facing direction")
	back = back.Unit
	local ground = V(spawnPosition.X, spawnPosition.Y - .3, spawnPosition.Z)
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(ground, Vector3.yAxis:Cross(back), Vector3.yAxis, back)
		* CFrame.new(layout.ShiftX, 0, layout.Distance)
end

-- A real eight-sided prism: three rectangular slabs and four horizontal
-- triangular wedges. No overlapping rotated squares or solid round proxy.
local function octagon(parent, origin, name, diameter, height, y, color)
	local shell = group(parent, name)
	local radius = diameter * .5
	local a, b = radius * math.cos(math.pi / 8), radius * math.sin(math.pi / 8)
	part(shell, origin, "CentralSlab", V(a * 2, height, b * 2), CFrame.new(0, y, 0), color, nil, true)
	for _, side in {-1, 1} do
		part(shell, origin, "Wing_" .. side, V(b * 2, height, a - b),
			CFrame.new(0, y, side * (a + b) * .5), color, nil, true)
	end
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local corner = CFrame.Angles(0, (index - 1) * math.pi / 2, 0)
		local horizontalWedge = CFrame.fromMatrix(V((a + b) * .5, y, (a + b) * .5),
			Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.zAxis)
		part(shell, origin, "BeveledCorner_" .. index, V(height, a - b, a - b),
			corner * horizontalWedge, color, nil, true, "WedgePart")
	end
	return shell
end

local function ring(parent, origin, name, radius, y, height, thickness, segments, color, material)
	local assembly = group(parent, name)
	local length = 2 * radius * math.tan(math.pi / segments) + .015
	for index = 1, segments do
		local angle = TAU * (index - 1) / segments
		part(assembly, origin, "Segment_" .. index, V(length, height, thickness),
			CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * radius, y, math.cos(angle) * radius)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0), color, material, false)
	end
	return assembly
end

local function marker(parent, origin, name, position)
	local object = part(parent, origin, name, V(.05, .05, .05), CFrame.new(position), C.black,
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
	object.Transparency = 1
	object.CastShadow = false
	return object
end

-- Build one 19.2-stud tube; tubeCFrame is the ground origin and local -Z is
-- its front. Markers are direct children and never inherit a second offset.
-- Public contract: PrimaryPart/StaticOrigin, DisplaySlot, SpecimenAnchor (8.7),
-- InjectorAnchor (14.5), Interaction.SpecimenTubePrompt (G).
function Geometry.build(parent: Instance, tubeCFrame: CFrame, slot: number): Model
	assert(parent and typeof(tubeCFrame) == "CFrame", "BioTube requires a parent and ground CFrame")
	assert(slot % 1 == 0 and slot >= 1 and slot <= 5, "BioTube slot must be 1..5")
	local tube = Instance.new("Model")
	tube.Name = "BioTube_" .. slot
	tube:SetAttribute("DisplaySlot", slot)
	tube:SetAttribute("StaticOrigin", tubeCFrame)
	tube:SetAttribute("BioTubeGeometryVersion", Geometry.Version)
	tube:SetAttribute("VisualHeight", Geometry.Height)
	tube:SetAttribute("VisualDiameter", Geometry.Diameter)
	tube:SetAttribute("IdleBubbleRate", 14)
	tube.Parent = parent
	local root = marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "TubeRoot", V(0, .025, 0))
	root.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(0, -.025, 0)
	tube.PrimaryPart = root
	local lower = group(tube, "LowerMechanicalAssembly")
	octagon(lower, tubeCFrame, "OctagonBase_Low", 12, 1.1, .55, C.iron)
	octagon(lower, tubeCFrame, "BevelBase_Upper", 10.4, .9, 1.55, C.steel)
	octagon(lower, tubeCFrame, "BottomLockCollar", 10.2, .35, 2.175, C.edge)
	for index = 1, 8 do
		local angle = (index - 1) * TAU / 8
		local radial = V(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle))
		local a, b = radial * 5.46 + V(0, .65, 0), radial * 4.82 + V(0, 3.25, 0)
		local delta = b - a
		part(lower, tubeCFrame, "MechanicalButtress_" .. index, V(.6, .72, delta.Magnitude),
			aimFrame((a + b) * .5, b), C.steel, nil, false)
		part(lower, tubeCFrame, "ButtressFoot_" .. index, V(.9, .3, .72),
			CFrame.new(radial * 5.33 + V(0, .25, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0), C.iron, nil, false)
		if index % 2 == 0 then
			part(lower, tubeCFrame, "LowerStatusLight_" .. index, V(.52, .13, .13),
				CFrame.new(radial * 5.67 + V(0, .85, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0), C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
		end
	end
	-- Six straight sections per pipe follow a curved return path; they are
	-- intentionally kept behind the side braces, away from the front specimen.
	for _, side in {-1, 1} do
		local pipeName = if side < 0 then "CoolantPipe_L" else "CoolantPipe_R"
		local path = {V(side * 3.6, 1.1, 3.0), V(side * 4.5, 1.65, 3.0),
			V(side * 5.2, 2.4, 2.7), V(side * 5.35, 3.15, 2.1),
			V(side * 5.1, 3.75, 1.4), V(side * 4.7, 3.95, .9), V(side * 4.4, 3.8, .6)}
		for index = 1, #path - 1 do
			beam(lower, tubeCFrame, pipeName .. "_" .. index, path[index], path[index + 1], .28, C.black, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		end
		for _, index in {1, #path - 1} do
			local a, b = path[index], path[index + 1]
			local center = a:Lerp(b, .5)
			local direction = (b - a).Unit
			beam(lower, tubeCFrame, pipeName .. "_Coupling_" .. index, center - direction * .16,
				center + direction * .16, .4, C.edge, Enum.Material.Metal)
		end
	end

	local chamber = group(tube, "ContainmentChamber")
	local bottomDisc = cylinder(chamber, tubeCFrame, "BottomGlowDisc", 9, .18,
		CFrame.new(0, 2.36, 0), Color3.fromRGB(185, 255, 205), Enum.Material.Neon, false)
	-- A hollow wall keeps the body visible without the two broad flat caps of
	-- a transparent solid cylinder. It is also the physical containment shell.
	local glass = ring(chamber, tubeCFrame, "GlassOuterWall", 4.84, 8.7, 13, .08, 24, C.glass, Enum.Material.Glass)
	for _, pane in glass:GetChildren() do
		pane.Transparency = .62
		pane.Reflectance = .03
		pane.CanCollide = true
		pane.CanQuery = true
	end
	local fluid = cylinder(chamber, tubeCFrame, "BioFluidColumn", 9.2, 12.7,
		CFrame.new(0, 8.65, 0), C.green, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
	fluid.Transparency = .84 -- Preserve the actual specimen silhouette through both layers.
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local angle = math.pi / 4 + (index - 1) * math.pi / 2
		part(chamber, tubeCFrame, "GlassSeamRail_" .. index, V(.12, 12.6, .12),
			CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * 4.94, 8.7, math.cos(angle) * 4.94), C.steel, nil, false)
	end
	local emitterAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	emitterAttachment.Name = "BioBubblesOrigin"
	-- BottomGlowDisc is rotated; this converts the world-up emitter frame into
	-- that disc's local frame, preventing sidewards bubbles on rotated bases.
	emitterAttachment.CFrame = bottomDisc.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(tubeCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0))
	emitterAttachment.Parent = bottomDisc
	local bubbles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	bubbles.Name = "BioBubbles"
	bubbles.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	bubbles.Color = ColorSequence.new(C.glow)
	bubbles.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8, .17), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, .11)})
	bubbles.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .75), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.85, .83), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	bubbles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2.6)
	bubbles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(4.2, 5.2)
	bubbles.Rate = 14
	bubbles.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	bubbles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(14, 14)
	bubbles.LightEmission = .65
	bubbles.LightInfluence = 0
	bubbles.LockedToPart = true
	bubbles.Parent = emitterAttachment
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "ContainmentGlow"
	light.Color = C.green
	light.Brightness = .35
	light.Range = 11
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = bottomDisc

	local head = group(tube, "MultiTieredMechanicalDome")
	ring(head, tubeCFrame, "OuterRecessedShroud", 5.43, 16.4, 1.6, .7, 16, C.iron, Enum.Material.Metal)
	ring(head, tubeCFrame, "CeilingNeonRing_Outer", 4.8, 15.55, .13, .15, 16, C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon)
	ring(head, tubeCFrame, "CeilingNeonRing_Inner", 3.6, 15.55, .13, .13, 16, C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon)
	cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "RibbedCoolingCore", 6.8, 1.1, CFrame.new(0, 15.35, 0), C.steel, nil, false)
	for index = 1, 24 do
		local angle = (index - 1) * TAU / 24
		part(head, tubeCFrame, "CoolingFin_" .. index, V(.12, .95, .45),
			CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * 3.48, 15.35, math.cos(angle) * 3.48) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0),
			C.edge, nil, false)
	end
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local angle = math.pi / 4 + (index - 1) * math.pi / 2
		local radial = V(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle))
		local a, b = radial * 5.2 + V(0, 15.85, 0), radial * 2.7 + V(0, 15.1, 0)
		local frame = aimFrame((a + b) * .5, b)
		local length = (b - a).Magnitude
		part(head, tubeCFrame, "AngledMechanicalStrut_" .. index, V(.45, .22, length), frame, C.steel, nil, false)
		for _, side in {-1, 1} do
			part(head, tubeCFrame, "StrutChannel_" .. index .. "_" .. side, V(.1, .55, length),
				frame * CFrame.new(side * .225, .1, 0), C.iron, nil, false)
		end
	end
	-- The specimen supplies a rotary collar at Y14.58..14.68 and its cable
	-- ports at Y14.385..14.615. Leave that whole central sweep unobstructed.
	-- Eight stationary feed valves are outboard of the rotating port envelope.
	cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "CentralInjectorHub", 3.8, .4, CFrame.new(0, 14.925, 0), C.steel, nil, false)
	cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "InjectorHubLowerCollar", 3.0, .1, CFrame.new(0, 14.75, 0), C.iron, nil, false)
	for index = 1, 8 do
		local angle = (index - 1) * TAU / 8
		local x, z = math.sin(angle) * 1.55, math.cos(angle) * 1.55
		cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "InjectorValveStem_" .. index, .1, .55,
			CFrame.new(x, 14.525, z), C.steel, nil, false)
		cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "InjectorNozzle_" .. index, .2, .3,
			CFrame.new(x, 14.1, z), C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
	end
	-- These five upper tiers close the shroud from above and make the complete
	-- authored silhouette reach Y=19.2, rather than ending at the old 17.2 cap.
	for _, tier in {
		{"UpperArmorDeck", 10.8, .7, 17.55, C.iron},
		{"RaisedBevelPlate", 9.6, .3, 18.05, C.steel},
		{"UpperLockRing", 7.7, .3, 18.35, C.edge},
		{"PowerCrown", 5.4, .4, 18.7, C.iron},
		{"CrownCap", 4.3, .3, 19.05, C.steel},
	} do
		cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, tier[1], tier[2], tier[3], CFrame.new(0, tier[4], 0), tier[5], nil, false)
	end

	local panel = part(lower, tubeCFrame, "TubeControlPanel", V(2.3, 1.3, .25),
		CFrame.new(0, 2.95, -5.23), C.black, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
	label(panel, slot)
	marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "SpecimenAnchor", V(0, 8.7, 0))
	marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "InjectorAnchor", V(0, 14.5, 0))
	local interaction = marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "Interaction", V(0, 3.1, -6.8))
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "SpecimenTubePrompt"
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.G
	prompt.ActionText = "Chọn khủng long"
	prompt.ObjectText = if slot == 5 then "Ống #5 · Trung tâm" else "Ống #" .. slot
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 11
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt:SetAttribute("DisplaySlot", slot)
	prompt.Parent = interaction
	local partCount = 0
	for _, object in tube:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then partCount += 1 end
	end
	tube:SetAttribute("StaticPartCount", partCount)
	return tube
end

-- the two presentation pivots; no character, physics joint or source art changes.
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Specimen = {}

-- These are landmarks of the shipped T-Rex, not a replacement dinosaur.
-- Offset is a fraction of the selected real mesh's aligned half extents.
-- Normal is the direction from the skin toward the cable.

local function eachCorner(part: BasePart, callback)
	local half = part.Size * .5
	for _, x in {-1, 1} do
		for _, y in {-1, 1} do
			for _, z in {-1, 1} do
				callback(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z)))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function bounds(parts: {BasePart}, frame: CFrame?): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local low = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local high = -low
	for _, part in parts do
		eachCorner(part, function(world)
			local point = if frame then frame:PointToObjectSpace(world) else world
			low = Vector3.new(math.min(low.X, point.X), math.min(low.Y, point.Y), math.min(low.Z, point.Z))
			high = Vector3.new(math.max(high.X, point.X), math.max(high.Y, point.Y), math.max(high.Z, point.Z))
		end)
	end
	return low, high
end

local function realParts(model: Model): {BasePart}
	local parts = {}
	for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.Anchored = true
			object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = false, false, false
			object.AssemblyLinearVelocity, object.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			if object.Transparency < 1 then table.insert(parts, object) end
		end
	end
	assert(#parts > 0, "The real specimen visual has no visible geometry")
	return parts
end

local function namedPart(model: Model, name: string): BasePart
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	assert(part and part:IsA("BasePart"), "Missing real specimen anatomy: " .. name)
	return part
end

local function fit(model: Model, origin: CFrame)
	local parts = realParts(model)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	-- Imported mesh art faces diagonally relative to its rig root. Derive the
	-- anatomy's forward direction before centering; otherwise a fixed #5 turns away.
	local forward = namedPart(model, "head_geom").Position - namedPart(model, "body_geom").Position
	forward = Vector3.new(forward.X, 0, forward.Z)
	assert(forward.Magnitude > .001, "Cannot determine the specimen's forward direction")
	local heading = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, forward.Unit)
	model:PivotTo(heading:Inverse() * model:GetPivot())
	local low, high = bounds(parts)
	local center, radius = (low + high) * .5, 0
	for _, part in parts do
		eachCorner(part, function(point)
			local offset = point - center
			radius = math.max(radius, Vector2.new(offset.X, offset.Z).Magnitude)
		end)
	end
	-- Radius of every part corner includes the entire tail at every yaw angle.
	-- Checking only width and depth would clip the glass midway through rotation.
	local factor = math.min(MAX_RADIUS / math.max(radius, .001), MAX_HEIGHT / math.max(high.Y - low.Y, .001))
	model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * factor)
	low, high = bounds(parts)
	center = (low + high) * .5
	model:PivotTo(origin * CFrame.new(0, CENTER_Y, 0) * CFrame.new(-center) * model:GetPivot())
	return factor, radius * factor, (high.Y - low.Y)
end

local function axisFrame(position: Vector3, axis: Vector3): CFrame
	local reference = if math.abs(axis:Dot(Vector3.yAxis)) > .95 then Vector3.zAxis else Vector3.yAxis
	local up = (reference - axis * reference:Dot(axis)).Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, axis, up, axis:Cross(up))
end

local function cylinder(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, frame: CFrame, color: Color3, neon: boolean?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name, part.Shape, part.Size, part.CFrame = name, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, size, frame
	part.Color, part.Material = color, if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Metal
	part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.TopSurface, part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function surfacePoint(part: BasePart, socket, origin: CFrame): (Vector3, Vector3, boolean)
	local low, high = bounds({part}, origin)
	local center, half = (low + high) * .5, (high - low) * .5
	local offset = socket.Offset
	local target = origin:PointToWorldSpace(center + Vector3.new(half.X * offset.X, half.Y * offset.Y, half.Z * offset.Z))
	local normal = origin:VectorToWorldSpace(socket.Normal).Unit
	local reach = part.Size.Magnitude * 2 + 2
	local parameters = RaycastParams.new()
	parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = {part}
	parameters.IgnoreWater = true
	-- Only this clone is made queryable, only while sampling its actual collision
	-- surface. This never changes the original rig or broadens gameplay queries.
	local previous = part.CanQuery
	part.CanQuery = true
	local ok, hit = pcall(function()
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(target + normal * reach, -normal * reach * 2, parameters)
		if not result then
			result = Workspace:Raycast(part.Position + normal * reach, -normal * reach * 2, parameters)
		end
		return result
	end)
	part.CanQuery = previous
	if ok and hit and hit.Instance == part then return hit.Position, hit.Normal, true end
	-- ServerStorage / isolated inspection has no Workspace collision world. A
	-- genuine part-surface fallback keeps the attachment on the mesh's bounds;
	-- production mounts in Workspace normally use the surface raycast above.
	local localTarget = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(target)
	local localNormal = part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(normal)
	local h = part.Size * .5
	local ratios = {
		{math.abs(localNormal.X), "X"}, {math.abs(localNormal.Y), "Y"}, {math.abs(localNormal.Z), "Z"},
	}
	table.sort(ratios, function(a, b) return a[1] > b[1] end)
	local x, y, z = math.clamp(localTarget.X, -h.X, h.X), math.clamp(localTarget.Y, -h.Y, h.Y), math.clamp(localTarget.Z, -h.Z, h.Z)
	local side = ratios[1][2]
	local n
	if side == "X" then x = h.X * (if localNormal.X >= 0 then 1 else -1); n = Vector3.new(math.sign(x), 0, 0)
	elseif side == "Y" then y = h.Y * (if localNormal.Y >= 0 then 1 else -1); n = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(y), 0)
	else z = h.Z * (if localNormal.Z >= 0 then 1 else -1); n = Vector3.new(0, 0, math.sign(z)) end
	return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x, y, z)), part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(n), false
end

function Specimen.mount(tube: Model, template: Model, record: table): Model
	assert(tube and tube:IsA("Model"), "A BioTube model is required")
	assert(template and template:IsA("Model"), "The real TRex specimen visual is required")
	assert(type(record) == "table" and record.SpeciesId == "TRex", "Unsupported specimen species")
	local slot = tube:GetAttribute("DisplaySlot")
	assert(type(slot) == "number" and slot >= 1 and slot <= 5 and slot % 1 == 0, "BioTube requires DisplaySlot 1..5")
	local configuredOrigin = tube:GetAttribute("StaticOrigin")
	local origin = if typeof(configuredOrigin) == "CFrame" then configuredOrigin else tube:GetPivot()
	local previous = tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly")
	local assembly = Instance.new("Model")
	assembly.Name = "SpecimenAssembly_Pending"
	assembly.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
	assembly:PivotTo(origin)
	assembly.Parent = tube
	local ok, result = xpcall(function()
		local model = template:Clone()
		assert(model, "The sanitized TRex template is not archivable")
		model.Name, model.Parent = "Specimen", assembly
		local factor, radius, height = fit(model, origin)
		local implants = Instance.new("Folder")
		implants.Name, implants.Parent = "ImplantSockets", model
		local rotor = Instance.new("Model")
		rotor.Name, rotor.Parent = "RotatingInjector", assembly
		rotor:PivotTo(origin)
		cylinder(rotor, "InjectorRotaryCollar", Vector3.new(.10, 2.60, 2.60), origin * axisFrame(Vector3.new(0, INJECTOR_Y + .13, 0), Vector3.yAxis), STEEL)
		local cables = Instance.new("Folder")
		cables.Name, cables.Parent = "BioTetherCables", assembly
		local raycastCount = 0
		for index, socket in SOCKETS do
			local part = namedPart(model, socket.Part)
			local point, normal, sampled = surfacePoint(part, socket, origin)
			if sampled then raycastCount += 1 end
			local pierce = Instance.new("Attachment")
			pierce.Name = "Pierce_" .. socket.Name
			pierce.CFrame = part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(axisFrame(point, normal))
			pierce:SetAttribute("SurfaceSampled", sampled)
			pierce.Parent = part
			local implant = cylinder(implants, "ImplantSocket_" .. socket.Name, Vector3.new(.26, .26, .26), axisFrame(point + normal * .02, normal), STEEL)
			implant:SetAttribute("BodyPartName", part.Name)
			cylinder(implants, "ImplantGlow_" .. socket.Name, Vector3.new(.05, .28, .28), axisFrame(point + normal * .09, normal), GREEN, true)
			local endpoint = Instance.new("Attachment")
			endpoint.Name = "CableEnd_" .. socket.Name
			endpoint.CFrame = implant.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(axisFrame(point + normal * .15, -normal))
			endpoint.Parent = implant
			local angle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / #SOCKETS
			local portRadius = if index % 2 == 0 then .80 else 1.14
			local portPosition = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * portRadius, INJECTOR_Y, math.sin(angle) * portRadius)
			local port = cylinder(rotor, "InjectorPort_" .. index, Vector3.new(.23, .24, .24), origin * axisFrame(portPosition, -Vector3.yAxis), STEEL)
			cylinder(rotor, "InjectorPortGlow_" .. index, Vector3.new(.05, .255, .255), origin * axisFrame(portPosition - Vector3.new(0, .07, 0), -Vector3.yAxis), GREEN, true)
			local start = Instance.new("Attachment")
			start.Name = "CableStart_" .. socket.Name
			local radial = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
			local tangent = (radial * .7 - Vector3.yAxis).Unit
			start.CFrame = port.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(origin * axisFrame(portPosition - Vector3.new(0, .12, 0), tangent))
			start.Parent = port
			local cable = Instance.new("Beam")
			cable.Name = "BioCable_" .. socket.Name
			cable.Attachment0, cable.Attachment1 = start, endpoint
			cable.FaceCamera, cable.Segments = true, 16
			cable.Width0, cable.Width1 = socket.Width, socket.Width * .86
			cable.CurveSize0 = if socket.Name:find("Rib", 1, true) then 2.20 else 1.55
			cable.CurveSize1 = if socket.Normal.Y == 1 then .55 else 1.18
			cable.Color = ColorSequence.new(if socket.Fluid then GREEN else BLACK)
			cable.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(if socket.Fluid then .16 else 0)
			cable.LightEmission = if socket.Fluid then .65 else .04
			cable.LightInfluence = if socket.Fluid then .25 else .75
			cable:SetAttribute("PierceName", pierce.Name)
			cable:SetAttribute("FluidLine", socket.Fluid == true)
			cable.Parent = cables
		end
		assembly:SetAttribute("StaticOrigin", origin)
		assembly:SetAttribute("SpecimenRestPivot", model:GetPivot())
		assembly:SetAttribute("InjectorRestPivot", rotor:GetPivot())
		assembly:SetAttribute("DisplaySlot", slot)
		assembly:SetAttribute("AngularSpeedDegrees", if slot == 5 then 0 else 10)
		assembly:SetAttribute("BobAmplitude", .12)
		assembly:SetAttribute("BobFrequency", .22)
		assembly:SetAttribute("SpecimenId", tostring(record.Id or ""))
		assembly:SetAttribute("SpeciesId", "TRex")
		assembly:SetAttribute("FittedRadius", radius)
		assembly:SetAttribute("FittedHeight", height)
		assembly:SetAttribute("ScaleFactor", factor)
		assembly:SetAttribute("TetherCount", #SOCKETS)
		assembly:SetAttribute("SurfaceRaycastCount", raycastCount)
		assembly:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
		return assembly
	end, function(exception) return debug.traceback(tostring(exception), 2) end)
	if not ok then assembly:Destroy(); error(result, 2) end
	if previous then previous:Destroy() end
	assembly.Name = "SpecimenAssembly"
	CollectionService:AddTag(assembly, TAG)
	return assembly
end

-- Server-authoritative slots; static scenery is authored in Edit and reused at runtime.
local Geometry = require(script.Parent.BioTubeGeometry)
local Specimen = require(script.Parent.BioTubeSpecimen)
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
local OFFSETS = {[1]=Vector3.new(-28,0,-10),[2]=Vector3.new(-15,0,0),
	[3]=Vector3.new(15,0,0),[4]=Vector3.new(28,0,-10),[5]=Vector3.new(0,0,5)}
local ANGLES = {[1]=22,[2]=11,[3]=-11,[4]=-22,[5]=0}

function Service.buildWorld()
	local existing=workspace:FindFirstChild("SpecimenTubeDisplays")
	if existing and existing:GetAttribute("GeometryVersion")==Geometry.Version then return existing end
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local world=Instance.new("Folder");world.Name="SpecimenTubeDisplays"
	world:SetAttribute("GeometryVersion",Geometry.Version)
	world:SetAttribute("SystemVersion","P1-F.2")
	local bases=workspace:WaitForChild("DarkJungle"):WaitForChild("Bases")
	for id=1,12 do
		local base=assert(bases:FindFirstChild("Base"..id),"Missing base "..id)
		local spawn=assert(base:FindFirstChild("SpawnPad"),"Missing SpawnPad")
		local shelter=assert(base:FindFirstChild("ShelterFloor"),"Missing existing shelter")
		local origin=Geometry.clusterFrame(spawn.Position,shelter.Position,id)
		local cluster=Instance.new("Model");cluster.Name="Base"..id
		cluster:SetAttribute("BaseId",id);cluster:SetAttribute("ClusterOrigin",origin);cluster.Parent=world
		for slot=1,5 do
			local tube=Geometry.build(cluster,origin*CFrame.new(OFFSETS[slot])*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(ANGLES[slot]),0),slot)
			tube:SetAttribute("BaseId",id)
		end
	end
	world.Parent=workspace
	return world
end

function Service.new(economy,template)
	local self=setmetatable({Economy=economy,Template=template,World=Service.buildWorld(),Connections={},Players={}},Service)
	for _,cluster in self.World:GetChildren() do
		local id=cluster:GetAttribute("BaseId")
		-- Authored files never contain a player's specimen. Clear any stale local preview.
		for slot=1,5 do
			local tube=cluster:FindFirstChild("BioTube_"..slot)
			local old=tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly");if old then old:Destroy() end
			tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",nil);tube:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",nil)
			local prompt=tube.Interaction.SpecimenTubePrompt
			table.insert(self.Connections,prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				if player:GetAttribute("BaseId")~=id then economy:_notice(player,"Đây là ống nghiệm của base khác.");return end
				if not self:CanUse(player,slot) then economy:_notice(player,"Đến gần ống nghiệm của bạn, cất vũ khí bằng R và dừng động tác.");return end
				economy:Publish(player,nil,"Inventory")
				economy.Remote:FireClient(player,"OpenSpecimenTube",{Slot=slot})
			end))
		end
	end
	return self
end

function Service:CanUse(player,slot)
	if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>5 then return false end
	if not self.Economy:_quiet(player) then return false end
	local state=self.Economy.GetState(player)
	local profile=self.Economy:Profile(player)
	if state.InHunting or state.InTraining or not profile or profile.ActiveRun then return false end
	local cluster=self.World:FindFirstChild("Base"..tostring(player:GetAttribute("BaseId")))
	local tube=cluster and cluster:FindFirstChild("BioTube_"..slot)
	return tube~=nil and (state.Root.Position-tube.Interaction.Position).Magnitude<=13
end

function Service:Clear(player)
	local id=self.Players[player];self.Players[player]=nil
	local cluster=id and self.World:FindFirstChild("Base"..id)
	if not cluster or cluster:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")~=player.UserId then return end
	cluster:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",nil)
	for _,tube in cluster:GetChildren() do
		local assembly=tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly");if assembly then assembly:Destroy() end
		tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",nil);tube:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",nil)
	end
end

function Service:Sync(player,profile)
	local id=player:GetAttribute("BaseId")
	if self.Players[player] and self.Players[player]~=id then self:Clear(player) end
	local cluster=self.World:FindFirstChild("Base"..tostring(id));if not cluster then return end
	self.Players[player]=id;cluster:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",player.UserId)
	for slot=1,5 do
		local tube=cluster:FindFirstChild("BioTube_"..slot)
		local specimenId=profile.DisplaySlots and profile.DisplaySlots[slot]
		if tube:GetAttribute("SpecimenId")==specimenId and tube:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")==player.UserId then continue end
		local old=tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly");if old then old:Destroy() end
		tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",nil);tube:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",player.UserId)
		local record=specimenId and profile.OwnedSpecimens[specimenId]
		if record then
			local ok,result=pcall(Specimen.mount,tube,self.Template,record)
			if ok then tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",specimenId)
			else warn("[BioTubes] Could not mount specimen",id,slot,result) end
		end
	end
end

function Service:Destroy()
	for _,connection in self.Connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for player in self.Players do self:Clear(player) end
	self.Connections={}
end
return Service
